evidence: scene/world/render.rs:330-337 casts an unbounded primitive index to u32; mesh/stable_key.rs:7-17 checks the 16-bit ordinal only with debug_assert and OR-packs it; key(entity=1, ordinal=65536) equals key(entity=1, ordinal=0) in release.
impact_or_question: A model with more than 65,536 primitives can produce duplicate stable identities in release, corrupting history, draw-cache and hit-proxy association; debug builds panic instead.
next_action: Enforce the primitive ordinal bound at world extraction and any model-mesh fallback call, then add a boundary regression test for 65536.
